installed_package_size.caveat: Includes tauri-plugin-wdio + tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver (test-only WebDriver bridge, see src-tauri/Cargo.toml) -- inflates size vs. a real production build that would feature-gate these out.

measurement_notes: Measured on macOS via direct release-binary launch (built through `npm run tauri build`, NOT raw `cargo build --release` -- see README.md's 'Framework-specific considerations' for why that distinction matters).

cold_launch_ms and interaction_latency_ms captured via in-page performance.now() timestamps (instrumented in src/main.js), read through the WebdriverIO embedded provider -- avoids needing macOS Accessibility/Automation permission, which proved to require a fresh manual grant on every binary rebuild (ad-hoc-signed dev binary) and was abandoned as impractical for a repeatable measurement loop.
idle_memory_mb captured via `ps -o rss=` on the real OS process, 30s after launch, no interaction -- per #370's exact procedure.

'Cold launch' here is NOT preceded by a full reboot/disk-cache purge (no sudo/purge available in this environment) -- a real gap relative to the scorecard's frozen-cold-cache requirement. Must be redone in a true frozen measurement environment (reboot immediately before first run) alongside the Windows pass, per the scorecard's Measurement Environment Freeze section.
